records.title: Cantonment Boards.
details: c): In order to bring uniformity in municipal laws governing Cantonment areas and adjoining State municipalities, a proposal for excision of civil areas from the limits of select Cantonments and their merger with adjoining municipalities has been taken up with the concerned State Governments. Since the outcome of excision exercise may have a bearing on the governance structure of Cantonment Boards, elections to Cantonment Boards have not been conducted.
